# Calculus

The derivative: f'(x) = lim_{h→0} (f(x+h) − f(x)) / h

Chain rule: d/dx[f(g(x))] = f'(g(x)) · g'(x)

Integration by parts: ∫u dv = uv − ∫v du

Taylor series: f(x) = ∑ₙ₌₀∞ f⁽ⁿ⁾(a)/n! · (x−a)ⁿ

Gradient: ∇f = (∂f/∂x₁, ∂f/∂x₂, …, ∂f/∂xₙ)

Divergence: ∇ · F = ∂F₁/∂x₁ + ∂F₂/∂x₂ + ∂F₃/∂x₃

Curl: ∇ × F = (∂F₃/∂y − ∂F₂/∂z, ∂F₁/∂z − ∂F₃/∂x, ∂F₂/∂x − ∂F₁/∂y)

Laplace equation: ∇²φ = 0

The fundamental theorem: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx = F(b) − F(a)

Convergence: ∑ₙ₌₁∞ 1/n² = π²/6
